summary: Compose bounded native agent SQL capture, primary-key extraction, canonical input and private delivery-source storage for the agent collection integration.

replay.detail: Explicit installation pages existing source tables at up to128 rows/1MiB per snapshot; namespace canonical metadata repairs and finite captured clocks share a bounded maintenance budget. No startup scan, automatic replay, gap recovery or source-cut promotion is installed.

schema.detail: Explicit installation persists exact recursive-source descriptors and creates private delivery, namespace physical/canonical shadow, producer-boundary and singleton captured-clock tables. Normal Store opens remain unchanged; no numeric database version change.

rules.detail: Public card admission and mutable-verdict policy are unchanged. The explicit capture fingerprint binds the default st3 registry/projection digest and current unfiltered-verdict domain.

compatibility.detail: Existing v0 frames and generated clients are unchanged. Empty-key full refresh invalidates retained rows; pending independent source evidence retries without acknowledging the cursor. Paired grant expiry is rechecked on its deadline.

downtime.detail: No default reader activation or startup work. Complete card composition, real daemon parity and callback-cost qualification remain required before serving this source.

manual.detail: No deployment action activates these local integration helpers. Explicit source installation requires managed hooks, complete family/authority/deadline proof, a retained producer registration and one shared Store Publisher.

recovery.detail: Raw capture gaps, descriptor changes and unsupported source closure remain fenced. Temporary producer acknowledgement/dirty output gaps use bounded collection retries. Restore or changed source epoch needs a separately qualified namespace-binding lifecycle.
